categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and refactors unit tests in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp to improve test cleanliness and eliminate shared mutable state.
categories.rationale: Splits a monolithic 300-line unit test into independent test cases and eliminates mutable global state (`g_dust`, `g_bare_multi`) to prevent test-state leakage between assertions. While deferrable internal test cleanup, removing shared mutable state across subtests provides durable maintainability value for transaction test suites.
